sourceOpenUnits.requirement: Surgery is local therapy too, and in early breast cancer it is the most common one. This guide focuses on ablation and radiation, so read [breast surgery basics](/wiki/education/concepts/therapeutics/local-therapies/breast-surgery-basics), [completion surgery](/wiki/education/concepts/therapeutics/local-therapies/completion-surgery) and [regional nodal irradiation after neoadjuvant therapy](/wiki/education/concepts/therapeutics/local-therapies/regional-nodal-irradiation-after-neoadjuvant-therapy) for the operation and the radiation questions that follow it.
sourceOpenUnits.residual: The source sentence ranks surgery as the most common local therapy in early breast cancer; no read source establishes that comparative frequency.
